senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. pl. Bethshean (Scythopolis), in Galilee.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 6b:5">Ḥull. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>והתיר רבי את ב׳ ש׳ כולה</he> Rabbi permitted the entire territory of Bethshean (permitted its fruits to be eaten without tithes, it being considered foreign territory).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 2:4:2">Y. Kidd. II, 62ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>כלי פשתן … מב׳ ש׳</he> the finer linen garments that come from B.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 7:7:2">Y. Keth. VII, 31ᶜ</cite> <he>בית שָׁן</he>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:18:1">Koh. R. to I, 18</cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:20">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> <he>תהום ב׳ ש׳ וכ׳</he> the district of B. is named Kinnereth; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="B00746"><he>בֵּישַׁן</he></cite>.
